root_text:
Human metapneumovirus (hMPV) 
It spreads like other common cold through infectious respiratory particles that spread through the air from a sick person to others. This means a person can catch the virus when they are close to a sick person

nodes.text:
Human metapneumovirus (hMPV) 
It spreads like other common cold through infectious respiratory particles that spread through the air from a sick person to others. This means a person can catch the virus when they are close to a sick person or sharing a closed space with them.
